description:
What is the best way to attach a deck to your house without causing water damage or structural issues? In this short, contractor Jeff Thorman explains how the Metwood deck bracket solves one of the most common problems with deck ledger boards.

PRODUCT IN THIS VIDEO
https://bit.ly/deckbracket

Traditional deck ledger installations can lead to water infiltration, rot, and long-term structural damage if not done correctly. The Metwood deck bracket is designed to improve how decks are attached to homes by addressing spacing, drainage, and load support.

What this video shows:
• How the Method deck bracket works
• Why deck ledger boards can fail
• How to prevent water damage behind a deck
• A better way to attach a deck to your house

Questions this video answers:
• What is the safest way to attach a deck to a house?
• How do you prevent deck ledger rot?
• What causes deck ledger failure?
• Do you need a bracket for deck installation?

Jeff Thorman is a professional contractor and creator
title: This Deck Bracket Solves a Major Problem For Decks Attached to Your Home
